description: Header file for URL helper functions in a C project, providing functions for executing HTTP requests, multipart uploads, file downloads, and related utilities, utilizing libcurl and custom data structures.

methods.name: createMimeFileInfo
methods.description: Creates and initializes a MimeFileInfo structure.

methods.name: destroyMimeFileInfo
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a MimeFileInfo structure.

methods.name: createMimePartInfo
methods.description: Creates and initializes a MimePartInfo structure.

methods.name: destroyMimePartInfo
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a MimePartInfo structure.

methods.name: urlHelperExecuteVariableRequest
methods.description: Executes an HTTP request with variable substitution, supporting POST or GET methods, returning response body.

methods.name: urlHelperExecuteRequest
methods.description: Executes a simple HTTP request, with optional basic authentication, returning response body.

methods.name: urlHelperExecuteRequestHeaders
methods.description: Executes an HTTP request with custom headers, supporting authentication, returning response body.

methods.name: urlHelperExecuteMultipartRequestHeaders
methods.description: Performs a multipart HTTP POST request with headers and returns response body.

methods.name: urlHelperDownloadFile
methods.description: Downloads a file from a URL into a specified local path, returning number of bytes written.

methods.name: applyStandardCurlOptions
methods.description: Configures a CURL handle with standard options, including URL and timeout.

methods.name: urlHelperCanVerifyHost
methods.description: Checks if a URL string can be verified for host IP address matching.

methods.name: urlHelperCancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing transfer requests matching the given URL.

ctags.name: contentType
ctags.pattern: /^    char *contentType;      \/\/The content type of the file (ex. "text\/plain", "application\/x/

ctags.name: dataLength
ctags.pattern: /^    size_t dataLength;      \/\/The length of the data block (curl expects size_t)$/

ctags.name: localFilePath
ctags.pattern: /^    char *localFilePath;    \/\/The path to the local file$/

ctags.name: partData
ctags.pattern: /^    char *partData;         \/\/A string representation of data to be the body of a part$/

ctags.name: partName
ctags.pattern: /^    char *partName;         \/\/The name of the part for this file$/

ctags.name: remoteFileName
ctags.pattern: /^    char *remoteFileName;   \/\/The name to use for the file on the remote side$/
